newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firm late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firm late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate remained unchanged at 14.00 percent in thin activities near the Monday close despite moderate liquidity partly helped by imported swap funds, dealers said.
"The market is quiet as if dealers are waiting for changes in Thai politics," said a Thai bank dealer.

She referred to a weekend announcement by Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa that he would quit within seven days after his coalition partners threatened to withdraw support following three days of a no-confidence debate against him in parliament.
Analysts said former army chief and current defence minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh is the front-runner for the premiership.
The baht firmed to 25.380-25.384 to the dollar late on Monday from 25.388-25.395 late on Friday in subdued trading as the Tokyo market was closed for a holiday.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium stayed stable at its Monday morning level of 10.00-10.50 satangs per dollar but was easier than 10.25-10.75 late on Friday.
The central bank on Monday fixed the baht/dollar midrate unchanged at 25.39.
